name: Multiplayer Peeking
author: FoggyWhale
description:
联机模式下，鼠标悬停在队友状态栏/身体上可以查看队友手牌；当队友有虚弱、易伤、减少敌人力量、联机专属卡牌时，会给予紫色光效提示。
In multiplayer mode, you can peek the cards in your ally's hand by hovering the mouse over the ally's status-bar or body. When some ally has a card with WeakPower, VulnerablePower, Reducing enemy strength or MultiplayerOnly, there will be a purple glow present as a hint.
